# DATABASE: LayersTesting

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Version | 20261025 V1 |
| Description | Persistence stores and typed interfaces for the LayersTesting cash ledger. |
| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md |

## Questions

- None.

## Persistence Boundary

| Boundary | Rule |
|----------|------|
| Raw storage access | Only the generated `persistence/` package reaches the store. |
| Caller dependency | Features depend on declared access patterns and their DTOs, not on schemas. |
| Implementation | Generated from this file at the DATABASE build step; never written by hand. |
| Money | Amounts are integer cents in the `amount` column; no floating point at any layer. |
| Aggregates | Counts, balances, and report totals are computed by callers from `list` results; no aggregate operation exists. |

|-------|------|-------|

| account | VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account) | Owning account. |

| memo | VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | 0 to 60 characters, no comma or newline. |

=== AC accounts-create ===
Intent: accounts.create stores an account that accounts.get reads back with the supplied name.

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    code = "ACPTCR1"
    name = "Acceptance Create"
    created = db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)
    assert created.account == code
    assert created.name == name
    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)
    assert got is not None
    assert got.account == code
    assert got.name == name
=== END AC accounts-create ===

=== AC accounts-get ===
Intent: accounts.get returns the row for a present account and None for an absent one.

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    code = "ACPTGT1"
    absent = "ACPTGT2"
    name = "Acceptance Get"
    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)
    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)
    assert got is not None
    assert got.name == name
    assert db.accounts.get(account=absent) is None
=== END AC accounts-get ===

=== AC accounts-list ===
Intent: accounts.list returns created accounts in ascending code order.

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    first = "ACPTLA1"
    second = "ACPTLB1"
    db.accounts.create(account=second, name="Second")
    db.accounts.create(account=first, name="First")
    codes = [row.account for row in db.accounts.list()]
    assert first in codes
    assert second in codes
    assert codes.index(first) < codes.index(second)
    assert codes == sorted(codes)
=== END AC accounts-list ===

=== AC accounts-update ===
Intent: accounts.update changes only the name and returns None for an absent account.

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    code = "ACPTUP1"
    absent = "ACPTUP2"
    before = "Before Name"
    after = "After Name"
    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=before)
    updated = db.accounts.update(account=code, name=after)
    assert updated is not None
    assert updated.account == code
    assert updated.name == after
    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)
    assert got is not None
    assert got.name == after
    assert db.accounts.update(account=absent, name=after) is None
=== END AC accounts-update ===

from persistence.testing import db_session

    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None
    removed = db.accounts.delete(account=code)
    assert removed is not None
    assert removed.account == code
    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None
=== END AC accounts-delete ===

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    acct = "ACPTTC1"
    cat = "ACPTTCC1"
    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name="Txn Account")
    db.categories.create(category=cat, description="Txn Category")
    new_id = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1
    day = "2026-05-01"
    cents = 4550
    memo = "created row"
    created = db.transactions.create(

from persistence.testing import db_session

with db_session() as db:
    acct_a = "ACPTTLA"
    acct_b = "ACPTTLB"
    cat = "ACPTTLC"
    db.accounts.create(account=acct_a, name="List A")
    db.accounts.create(account=acct_b, name="List B")
    db.categories.create(category=cat, description="List Category")
    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0)
    id_a = base + 1
    id_b = base + 2
    db.transactions.create(txn_id=id_b, date="2026-05-03", account=acct_b, category=cat, amount=200, memo="")
    db.transactions.create(txn_id=id_a, date="2026-05-03", account=acct_a, category=cat, amount=100, memo="")
    ids = [t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()]
    assert ids == sorted(ids)
    assert id_a in ids and id_b in ids
    only_a = db.transactions.list(account=acct_a)
    assert [t.txn_id for t in only_a] == [id_a]
    assert all(t.account == acct_a for t in only_a)

## Schemas

## `accounts`

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| account | VARCHAR(12) PK | Account code, 1 to 12 characters of A-Z and 0-9. |
| name | VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL | 1 to 40 characters, no comma or newline. |

## `categories`

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| category | VARCHAR(12) PK | Category code, 1 to 12 characters of A-Z and 0-9. |
| description | VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL | 1 to 40 characters, no comma or newline. |

## `transactions`

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| txn_id | INTEGER PK | Kept from the load file, or max plus one when posted. |
| date | VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL | Real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| account | VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account) | Owning account. |
| category | VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(category) | Category. |
| amount | INTEGER NOT NULL | Signed integer cents, never zero. |
| memo | VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | 0 to 60 characters, no comma or newline. |

## Migrations

Each relational change has one staged record in `migrations/MIGRATION-<AccessPatternId>.md`.
The record carries Alembic `upgrade`/`downgrade` snippets and progresses from `planned` to `built`
only when its DATABASE build story completes. Alembic records deployment application separately.

## Guardrails

- Amounts are stored as integer cents; no column or caller uses floating point for money.
- Application code never opens a database driver; it calls the generated persistence package only.
- No aggregate, report, or balance value is stored; every one is computed from `list` results.
